δραχμαῖος.m: worth a drachma, to the amount of a drachma

n: Drius, the name of several mountains in Ancient Greece

δρομή.m: a course, running, race; the footrace

n: Dromichaetes, a king of the Getae
Dropici, a Persian nomadic tribe mentioned by Herodotus
A city of Phocis destroyed by the Persians, now Glunitsa
A fortified place situated between Attica and Boeotia
a female given name, Drypetis, from Old Persian, a Persian princess and wife of Hephaestion

δρώψ.m: Hesychius gives the definition as: ἄνθρωπος (ánthrōpos, “human”)
